answer: The Bell circuit ran on the free mock with 100 shots and finished successfully. The circuit puts H on qubit 0, then a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, then measures both qubits. The server has no alias called "garnet-mock". It lists "garnet:mock" as the Garnet mock, so I used that alias. I did not use any real QPU. The job ID is 01a15f59-874a-7014-97bf-a8202b92c695. The counts in Qiskit bit order were 00: 20, 01: 25, 10: 29, 11: 26. The mock returns random results, so the counts are spread evenly. A real QPU would return mostly 00 and 11. The scripts are /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-370/list_qc.py and /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-370/run_bell.py.
